plan.summary: Three Q-requested UI tweaks to the Veri Yönetimi surface: (1) shorten the two tab labels to 'Listeler' and 'Export'; (2) remove the Kampanya filter dropdown from the Export tab; (3) remove the per-campaign PDF report section from the Export tab. Frontend/SPA only; no backend, DB, or API change. Removing the PDF section also drops the jsPDF/jspdf-autotable imports, shrinking the ExportManagerPage bundle ~415KB -> ~15KB.
plan.q_intent: sekmelerin adı Listeler ve Export. export da kampanya filtresini kaldır, pdf i export bölümünü kaldır.
plan.interview_notes: Reverses two earlier interview choices (Q changed their mind): the Kampanya filter (was added as the 5th filter) and the kept PDF report section are both removed. Filter bar is now Şablon · Data Listesi (membership) · Teslim Durumu · Tarih. The ExportFilter.jobId field is left in the type/DTO (harmless; never set by the UI now). The Outbound filter-options endpoint still returns campaigns (unused by the client now) and getSendReportData/listSendJobs remain in api.ts (dead-but-exported; backend endpoints untouched).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The two Veri Yönetimi tabs read 'Listeler' (import) and 'Export' (export); navigation/paths unchanged.

The Export tab no longer shows a Kampanya filter dropdown nor a Kampanya active-filter chip; the remaining filters (Şablon, Data Listesi, Teslim Durumu, Tarih) still drive the live count and CSV/Excel/Liste Oluştur, and jobId is no longer set from the UI.

The 'Kampanya Raporu (PDF)' section is removed; jsPDF/jspdf-autotable + the tr()/TR_MAP helpers + pdf state/handler are gone with no unused-import/var errors; SPA build (tsc+vite) PASSES and the ExportManagerPage chunk shrinks (PDF deps dropped).

files_changed.change: removed Kampanya filter Select + chip; removed PDF section + exportPdf + pdfJobId + jsPDF/autotable/tr/TR_MAP/FileType2/SendReportData imports

build.command: cd src/Invekto.Backend/Dashboard && npm run build (tsc && vite build)

verification_questions.question: After removing the Kampanya filter and PDF section, are there NO unused imports/vars left (jsPDF, autoTable, FileType2, SendReportData, tr, TR_MAP, pdfJobId, exportPdf), so tsc --noUnusedLocals and the vite build pass cleanly?

Does removing the Kampanya filter leave the remaining filters functional and the count/export/create-list calls intact, with ExportFilter.jobId simply never set from the UI (no broken reference to options.campaigns or filter.jobId chip)?

Is this strictly a frontend change that does NOT touch any backend endpoint, Outbound service, DB, or tenant-scoped query — the filter-options/count/recipients/create-list/history APIs and their auth gating are unchanged?
Do the affected pages remain behind the same ProtectedRoute auth gate (no route/auth change in this diff), i.e. the tweaks are label text + element removal only?

forbidden_areas: Routing in App.tsx / nav in Layout.tsx (unchanged — separate committed change)
ExportFilter DTO / Outbound filter-options campaigns (left intact; only the client stops using them)
non_goals: Removing the now-unused getSendReportData/listSendJobs api.ts methods or the Outbound report-data/send-jobs endpoints (left for back-compat / other consumers)
Removing jobId from the ExportFilter type
intentional_exclusions: Server-side 'campaigns' filter-option payload kept (harmless; avoids touching Outbound for a pure UI removal)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Pure UI element/label removal. No data paths added or removed at the service layer; the remaining export/count/create-list flows keep their existing error handling (FailAsync audit + INV-OB mapping). No new catch blocks.

aha_moments.user_pain: Long tab labels ('Veri İçe Aktarma (Listeler)') were verbose and redundant with the page context.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator scans two crisp tab names instead of reading a sentence.

aha_moments.user_pain: The Kampanya filter overlapped conceptually with Şablon/Data Listesi and cluttered the filter bar.
aha_moments.suggestion: Drop the Kampanya dropdown; keep Şablon/Data Listesi/Teslim Durumu/Tarih.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator sees a leaner filter bar focused on the dimensions they actually segment by.

aha_moments.user_pain: The Export page shipped the heavy jsPDF/autotable bundle for a rarely-used PDF section (~415KB chunk).
aha_moments.suggestion: Remove the PDF section and its imports.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The Export tab loads ~15KB instead of ~415KB — noticeably snappier first paint.

aha_moments.user_pain: Two ways to export (filtered CSV/Excel vs per-campaign PDF) muddled the page's purpose.
aha_moments.suggestion: Keep the single filter-driven CSV/Excel/Liste Oluştur flow.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator has one clear export model — filter, then pick a format.

aha_moments.user_pain: Support had to explain a PDF picker that behaved differently from the filter-driven export.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support describes one workflow regardless of format.

verdict.notes: First-pass PASS. All CQ1-12 + CoVe Q1-Q4 PASS, zero blocking issues. Pure frontend UI tweaks (tab labels + Kampanya filter removal + PDF section removal with dependency cleanup); scope/auth/data all clean.
